Clinical_Takeaway: Textbook benign variant: high population frequency (>0.1%) concordant with benign in silico scores.
False-positive in silico outlier: high REVEL/AM scores overridden by stand-alone population frequency (BA1).
Strong concordant evidence: absent in gnomAD and located in MYH7 critical motor domain (aa 181-937).
Predictor discordance: high REVEL (0.966) in motor domain while AlphaMissense scores ambiguous (0.396).
High in silico scores alone (AM=0.997) with absence in gnomAD are insufficient to upgrade a VUS without clinical data.
